title: 2001 – Establishment of WTIA
author: hkwtia
plainText: The Inauguration Ceremony of WTIA was held at Hong Kong Productivity Council, with the exhibition Wireless Application Showcase. 20 companies showcased their latest mobile and wireless application in the Showcase.
